criteria.name: Data Understanding & Quality Checks
criteria.guidance: Inspect dates, stores, items and sales; validate duplicates, missing dates, target values, series coverage and frequency.

criteria.name: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)
criteria.guidance: Explore trend, seasonality, weekday/month patterns and store/item differences with appropriate time-series visualizations.

criteria.name: Data Cleaning & Time Features
criteria.guidance: Parse and sort dates, investigate missing-period meaning, engineer valid time features and prevent future-data leakage.

criteria.name: Baseline Forecasting Model
criteria.guidance: Establish naive/seasonal-naive and/or regression baseline with chronological train/test separation.

criteria.name: Evaluation & Findings
criteria.guidance: Report MAE, RMSE and/or sMAPE on a future holdout, interpret errors and state forecasting limitations.
